description: Samagra Shiksha, Assam has signed MoUs with six organisations to bring AI and innovation into school education. The partnerships aim to improve learning outcomes, strengthen foundational skills and build teachers’ digital capabilities.
body_lead: Assam signs MoUs to bring AI, technology and innovation into school education Samagra Shiksha, Assam has signed MoUs with six organisations to bring AI and innovation into school education. The partnerships aim to improve learning outcomes, strengthen foundational skills and build teachers’ digital capabilities.
